description_en: Deletes a consumer group of a change tracking task (new version)
description_zh: 新版删除订阅任务消费组
kebab_example: aliyun dts delete-consumer-channel --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --consumer-group-id dtsktbb6jdn2000000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteConsumerChannel

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the DTS change tracking instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: DTS订阅实例所在地域的ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the instance ID.
You must specify one of the DtsInstanceId and DtsJobId parameters
parameters.help_zh:
订阅实例ID，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询。
参数DtsInstanceId与DtsJobId，两者必须传入其一
parameters.name: dts_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the change tracking task. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html to query the task ID.
You must specify one of the DtsInstanceId and DtsJobId parameters
parameters.help_zh:
订阅任务ID，可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209702.html查询。
参数DtsInstanceId与DtsJobId，两者必须传入其一
parameters.name: dts_job_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the consumer group. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264169.html operation to query the consumer group ID
parameters.help_zh: 消费组ID，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/264169.html接口查询消费组ID
parameters.name: consumer_group_id
